tools.name: search_campus_events
tools.description: Search campus events by date and topic. Use this tool when a student wants to discover events. It only reads event information and does not register students.

topic.description: Event topic, such as AI, web development, or hackathon.

max_results.description: Maximum results to return, between 1 and 10.

events.description: Matching events with event ID, name, date, time, and venue.

error.description: Empty when successful, otherwise an error message.

tools.name: summarize_event_page
tools.description: Retrieve and summarize the information from one public campus event page. Use this when a student wants details about a specific event.

event_url.description: HTTP or HTTPS URL of the public event page.

error.description: Empty when successful, otherwise an error message.

tools.name: save_event_shortlist
tools.description: Save a student's selected campus events to their shortlist. This modifies stored user data and should only be called after the student confirms the selection.

event_ids.description: List of selected event IDs. Must contain between 1 and 10 IDs.

error.description: Empty when successful, otherwise an error message.
